dialog.body: City Clerk's office, this is Sandra. Happy New Year's Eve almost, how can I help you?
Good afternoon, and thank you for taking my call. My name is Amara Okafor. I need to get a certified copy of a birth certificate, please, for a passport. Thank you.
Sure, I can help with that. Is the birth certificate for yourself, or for someone else?
It is for myself, thank you. I was born here in Newport, at the hospital. I am applying to renew, but my old papers are not in order, so they have asked for the certified copy.
Okay, good, then we should have the record. And you said certified, so that's the one with the raised seal, which is what the passport people want. A photocopy won't do.
Yes, yes, certified with the seal. Thank you for explaining. Please, what identification should I bring with me?
A current photo ID. A driver's license is the easiest. If you don't drive, a state ID or a passport that's still valid works too. It needs to be something not expired.
I have a Rhode Island driver's license. It is current, it expires in two years. Is that sufficient? Thank you.
That's perfect. Just bring that in with you. Do you know your parents' full names, including your mother's maiden name? We'll ask you to fill that in on the form.
Yes, I know them. I have them written down. Thank you. And may I come today? I could come this afternoon, if it is possible.
You could, we're open until we close at four today, and then we're closed tomorrow for New Year's Day. So if you can get here before four, we can probably do it while you wait.

Ah, that is very helpful, thank you. I must tell you, I am not sure I can leave. At my work, a coworker has called out again today, as he always does, and so I am covering his shift. I will have to see if somebody can relieve me.
Oh, that's no fun. Well, if you can't make it today, we're back open on Friday. Same hours, so you've got another chance.
Friday. Yes, thank you. I will try for today, and if not, then Friday. Is there a fee for the copy, please? I do not want to come without enough.

There is a fee per copy, and it's posted on the counter and on the city website. I don't want to quote you the wrong figure off the top of my head. Bring a little extra and you'll be fine, we take cash or check.
A check, yes, I will bring my checkbook. Thank you. And to whom should I make it payable, please?
Just make it out to the City of Newport. You can leave the amount blank until you get here and we'll tell you exactly what it is.
City of Newport, and leave the amount blank. Thank you, that is very clear. Is there anything else I should bring?

That's really it. Your license, the checkbook, and your parents' names. And if you've got your old passport or the application paperwork, bring that too in case you want to double-check what they asked for.
Yes, I have the letter from them. I will bring it. Thank you very much, you have been very kind.
My pleasure, Ms. Okafor. Hope you can get away from work. Have a safe New Year's.
Thank you, and the same to you. Good afternoon, and thank you again.
